title: 菜品分类统计
objective: 按菜品分类统计数量和总价，再筛选分类组。
statement: 按 category 分组，统计每类菜品数与当前菜单单价合计，只保留菜品数不少于 3 的分类，依次输出 category、dish_count、total_price。3 道也保留；这是当前菜单价格合计，不是销量或实收。
knowledge: GROUP BY category 使结果每行代表一个类别；COUNT(*) 数该类菜品，SUM(price) 加总在售菜品的当前菜单单价。
dishes 中热菜有 5 道、凉菜有 3 道，达到门槛；主食和饮品各 2 道。price 是当前菜单价，不是销量、取消订单处理结果或历史成交价格。
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 在分组后筛选，包含三道菜的边界。WHERE 用于分组前的行条件；WHERE COUNT(*) >= 3 是无效 SQL，因为 WHERE 阶段不能使用聚合值。
starterSql: -- 按分类统计，只保留菜品数量不少于 3 道的分类。

hints.text: 输出粒度是一行一个类别；先按类别聚合，再按该类菜品数筛组。
GROUP BY category 后用 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 筛组；COUNT(*) 数菜品行，SUM(price) 汇总当前菜单单价。
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS dish_count, SUM(price) AS total_price FROM dishes GROUP BY ____ HAVING ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS dish_count, SUM(price) AS total_price FROM dishes GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 先按 category 分组并分别计算菜品数量及当前 price 合计，再由 HAVING 保留至少三道菜的类别。这个总价不是销量或营业额。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS dish_count, SUM(price) AS total_price FROM dishes GROUP BY category;
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS dish_count, SUM(price) AS total_price FROM dishes GROUP BY category HAVING SUM(price) >= 150;
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS dish_count, SUM(price) AS total_price FROM dishes GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
